ev.estate_home.title: A bigger house
ev.estate_home.text: Your chest holds more than everyday life needs. Nearby a {home} is for sale: roomier, sturdier, with a good yard. They ask {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_home.buy.ok: You moved your things to the new place. Neighbours drop by to look, and the children run from room to room.
ev.estate_home.save: Keep the money and live as before
ev.estate_home.save.ok: The money stayed in the chest. A bit cramped, but calm.
ev.estate_land.title: Land for sale
ev.estate_land.text: A neighbour is selling a plot of ploughland by the river. Your own land feeds you in good times and bad, if the sky is kind. The plot costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_land.buy.ok: You walked the boundaries of your land. It is yours now, and so is its harvest.
ev.estate_land.buy_two.ok: You took two plots at once. Plenty of land now, and plenty of work too.
ev.estate_land.save.ok: The land went to someone else. Your money is safe, but the neighbour is richer.
ev.estate_slaves.title: The slave market
ev.estate_slaves.text: Slaves are sold at the market: captives and people sold for debt. A worker for the household costs {price} {coin}. Everyone here with money lives this way.
ev.estate_slaves.text.islamic: Slaves are sold at the market, captives from beyond the border. The law says a slave must be fed well and never burdened beyond his strength, and freeing a slave is counted a good deed. A worker costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.text.christian: Slaves are sold at the market, captives from the wars. The priests remind you that a slave has a soul too, and praise those who set people free. A worker costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.text.kiev: Kholops are sold at the market: captives from a campaign and people who sold themselves for debt. A kholop for the household costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.text.novgorod: Kholops are sold at the market: captives from a campaign and people who sold themselves for debt. A kholop for the household costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.text.vladimir: Kholops are sold at the market: captives from a campaign and people who sold themselves for debt. A kholop for the household costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.text.moscow: Kholops are sold at the market: captives from a campaign and people who sold themselves for debt. A kholop for the household costs {price} {coin}.
ev.estate_slaves.buy.ok: A new person lives in the house. He is silent and looks at the floor. The work will go faster now.
ev.estate_slaves.buy_two.ok: You brought two home. They keep close to each other and hardly speak the local tongue.
ev.estate_slaves.refuse.ok: You left the market empty-handed. Somehow your heart feels lighter.
ev.estate_drought.title: Drought
ev.estate_drought.text: No rain for the second month. The ears on your land stand low and dry. The harvest won't feed you.
ev.estate_drought.sell: Sell a plot while it still fetches a price
ev.estate_drought.sell.ok: The buyer beat the price down but paid at once. You have less land now.
ev.estate_drought.endure: Tighten belts and wait it out
ev.estate_drought.endure.ok: It was a hungry year. You ate less and sold what you could spare, but kept the land.
ev.estate_drought.water.success: You worked from dawn to dusk, and part of the field was saved.
ev.estate_drought.water.failure: It took all your strength, and the field dried up anyway. You fell ill from exhaustion.
ev.estate_land_claim.title: A claim on your land
ev.estate_land_claim.text: A noble neighbour says your plot belonged to his grandfather, and he has brought witnesses. The judge is waiting for both sides.
ev.estate_land_claim.court.success: You found old people who remembered the boundaries. The judge left the land to you.
ev.estate_land_claim.court.failure: The neighbour's witnesses spoke louder. The plot was taken, and you had to pay the judge as well.
ev.estate_land_claim.pay.ok: The neighbour took the money and never mentioned his grandfather again.
ev.estate_land_claim.yield: Give it up without a fight
ev.estate_land_claim.yield.ok: Arguing with the strong costs more. You gave up the plot and for a long time could not look that way.
ev.estate_harvest.text: A rich harvest on your own land: the barn is full, and part of the grain went to market.
ev.estate_runaway.title: A runaway
ev.estate_runaway.text: In the morning one of the slaves was gone. He left by the road in the night, taking bread and an old cloak.
ev.estate_runaway.text.RUS: In the morning one of the kholops was gone. He slipped into the forest in the night with bread and an old sheepskin.
ev.estate_runaway.chase.success: The runaway was found at the ford and brought back. He no longer meets your eyes.
ev.estate_runaway.chase.failure: You rode for three days, wore yourself out and came back with nothing.
ev.estate_runaway.let_go.ok: You did not give chase. One worker fewer, and one grudge fewer too.
ev.estate_revolt.title: The slaves rise
ev.estate_revolt.text: At night the slaves barred themselves in the barn and shout that they won't come out to work. Someone has already set the straw by the gate alight.
ev.estate_revolt.harsh.success: With the neighbours you broke down the doors. The ringleaders were punished, the rest went back to work. The silence in the house is heavy.
ev.estate_revolt.harsh.failure: You were wounded in the struggle, the fire caught the house, and two of them fled into the dark.
ev.estate_revolt.talk.success: They asked for better food and rest on feast days. You agreed, and the revolt died down.
ev.estate_revolt.talk.failure: While you talked, two climbed out through the roof and left with the silver.
ev.estate_revolt.free.ok: You freed two of them. The neighbours whisper that it was weakness, and the rest work more calmly.
ev.estate_freedom.title: A plea for freedom
ev.estate_freedom.text: An old slave who has served your house for many years asks to be set free. He is old, and his children grew up beside yours.
ev.estate_freedom.text.islamic: An old slave who has served your house for many years asks to be freed. Freeing a slave is a righteous deed, and the imam has said so more than once in the Friday sermon.
ev.estate_freedom.text.christian: An old slave who has served your house for many years asks to be set free. The priest said that freeing a man is pleasing to God.
ev.estate_freedom.text.kiev: An old kholop who has served your house for many years asks for his freedom. The priest said that freeing a man is pleasing to God.
ev.estate_freedom.text.novgorod: An old kholop who has served your house for many years asks for his freedom. The priest said that freeing a man is pleasing to God.
ev.estate_freedom.text.vladimir: An old kholop who has served your house for many years asks for his freedom. The priest said that freeing a man is pleasing to God.
ev.estate_freedom.text.moscow: An old kholop who has served your house for many years asks for his freedom. The priest said that freeing a man is pleasing to God.
ev.estate_freedom.free.ok: You wrote out his freedom. The old man wept, and the neighbours talked of your kind heart for a long time.
ev.estate_freedom.ransom.ok: He gave everything he had saved over the years and left a free man.
ev.estate_freedom.keep.ok: You refused. The old man works as before, but the house has grown quieter and colder.
